title: Genere, diritti e vulnerabilità
summary: This first volume of the series Ricerche su genere e inclusione tra accademia e società, promoted by Ca’ Foscari University’s CUG, explores the intersection of gender, rights, and vulnerability through a multidisciplinary lens. Contributions address EU equality policies, trafficking victim identification, institutional responsibility in gender-based violence, and embodied experiences of disability. The volume bridges academia and society, fostering inclusion and equity.
